presentation_order: lower frozen row index first; preserve historical request identity
tournament: power-of-two padded binary tree, root winner removal, update ancestors, repeat k times
request_reuse: per-execution canonical pair decision; no cross-execution cache
review: initial response plus two fresh reserved slots, majority; at most one review per request
independent_execution_slots: disjoint triples; matching hash alone does not establish stochastic independence
new_branch: unobserved within this execution; charged even if present in global offline table
failure: record spent calls, keep last complete output, stop aborted session
repair_baseline: from-scratch tournament with all legally observed request results cached
run_preflight: validate exact budget and pristine ledger before any response read
source_scope: response-content fingerprint plus query/request context; explicit query and N/K in evaluator
evaluation_failure: initial failure yields topk=null and blocks group metric; aborted valid fallback remains in denominator
